description: A minimalist white curtain tie-back, shaped like a folded fan or a bouquet of long, slender rods. The tie-back is cinched around a bundle of vertically aligned, ribbed sections, resembling a pleated fabric. The overall form is sleek and modern, with subtle shadows defining the folds and curves. The tie-back itself appears as a simple band or loop holding the 'curtain' sections together near the bottom. This item is likely intended to be a decorative accessory for curtains, providing a clean and unobtrusive way to hold them open.
